description:
ABOUT PELICO

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.


MISSION

As a Software Engineer (V.I.E.) based in Miami, you will be part of the Product & Engineering team, contributing to the development and scaling of Pelico’s AI-native platform while collaborating closely with both local operations and the Engineering teams in France.

You will help build and evolve a platform designed from the ground up to leverage AI, working on impactful software solutions that support complex industrial operations and Pelico’s customers.

This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing, AI-native tech environment, while contributing to the company’s international growth.




MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES


1. SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT & DELIVERY

 - Design, develop, and maintain features across Pelico’s platform (front-end, back-end, or full stack depending on profile).

 - Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code.

 - Contribute to AI-powered features and capabilities, leveraging AI technologies where relevant to enhance Pelico’s platform and customer solutions.

 - Collaborate with product managers and designers to deliver impactful solutions to customers.

 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


2. TECHNICAL SUPPORT FOR CLIENT PROJECTS

 - Support the deployment and integration of Pelico’s platform for U.S.-based clients.

 - Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in collaboration with customer success and data teams.

 - Contribute to improving performance, reliability, and scalability of client deployments.


3. COLLABORATION & KNOWLEDGE SHARING

 - Act as a bridge between the Miami team and the engineering team in Paris.

 - Contribute to global engineering best practices and internal documentation.

 - Support onboarding and mentoring of new team members if needed.




PROFILE


EDUCATION & BACKGROUND

 - Master’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.

 - 1–3 years of relevant experience (internships or first job) in software development, ideally in a SaaS or tech environment.

 - Eligible for the V.I.E. program (French or EU citizen, aged 18–28, registered on mon-vie-via.businessfrance.fr).


TECHNICAL SKILLS

 - Strong programming skills in Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.

 - Experience with modern web frameworks (React, Node.js, Django, or similar).

 - Familiarity with cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure) and APIs.

 - Knowledge of databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).

 - Understanding of CI/CD, Git, and agile development principles.

 - Interest in AI/ML technologies and their application to real-world software products.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - A unique opportunity to gain international experience while contributing to Pelico’s expansion in the U.S. market.

 - Hands-on exposure to an AI-native SaaS platform and a fast-paced tech environment, with mentoring from experienced engineers.

 - The chance to work cross-functionally with product, operations, and customer teams.

 - An inclusive and collaborative culture that values learning and innovation.




CONTRACT INFORMATION

 - Contract type: V.I.E. (Volontariat International en Entreprise)

 - Duration: 18 months

 - Location: Miami, Florida, USA

 - Compensation: According to Business France V.I.E. program standards

 - Reporting to: Engineering Lead – Pelico Miami 

Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
